description_en: Configures the export destination (SLS or OSS) at the instance level. The configuration is unique per instance and follows the "configure once, use multiple times" principle
description_zh: 配置导出的SLS 或者OSS 信息，实例级别唯一，遵循一次配置多次使用的原则
kebab_example: aliyun adb configure-result-export --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-wz9509beptiz0000 --export-type SLS --sls-info LogstoreTtl=10 SlsProject=test-project ResourceGroup=aps --oss-info ResultFileTtl=10 ExportBasePath=oss://testBucketName/data_result ResourceGroup=aps --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigureResultExport
